reason: Stock WebKit has no proxy credentials: its Automation session refuses them (userContexts.proxy.credentials), so the test's proxy login can't be set on a context
ignoreHTTPSErrors is acceptInsecureCerts in Strider, which Chromium refuses per context: CDP ignores certificate errors browser-wide
SOCKS proxy endpoints are refused (userContexts.proxy.scheme), and the harness has no SOCKS server to route through; the tests route through one
